subject: Scheduled maintenance on Saturday
body: Our fictional intranet will be unavailable Saturday 09:00–10:00. No action is required. Read the maintenance notice using your usual bookmark.
scenario: Legitimate maintenance notice. Low risk does not guarantee safety.

subject: URGENT: verify your account
body: Your account will be suspended within 24 hours. Sign in and enter your password to keep access. This is a synthetic training message.
scenario: Obvious impersonation with credential pressure, domain mismatches, and authentication failures.

subject: Workshop registration receipt
body: Your fictional workshop seat is reserved. A separate registration partner handles replies. No payment or account access is requested.
scenario: Legitimate delegated registration; a different Reply-To and link domain can create a false positive.

subject: Please sign in to review your payroll settings
body: Please sign in to review the attached-in-spirit payroll notice. No actual attachment exists. Use the review portal below.
scenario: Suspicious account lure despite passing authentication. Could represent an abused legitimate account; a pass is not a safety verdict.

subject: URGENT: water outage in fictional office
body: Please leave the affected meeting room immediately. Facilities staff will provide updates in person. No links or account action are required.
scenario: Legitimate urgent notice. Urgency alone should remain Low risk.

subject: Invoice review request
body: Please review invoice DEMO-104. This synthetic message includes a numeric-host link. Confirm the invoice through your known vendor contact before taking action.
scenario: Unusual numeric-host URL with unavailable authentication. Unknown results are not failures.

subject: Payroll announcement — final warning
body: Final warning: verify your account credentials immediately to avoid a suspended account. This literal markup must display as text.
scenario: Impersonation and credential pressure; literal HTML demonstrates safe text rendering.
